answer: Problem: Sybil rings stage many wallets on one upstream to harvest early panel weight. Mechanism: a joiner climbs a terrace of 3 timed stake rungs (1.8→2.4→3.1 POA) spaced ≥25 minutes, posts a yarrow bloom hash H(pubkey||rung_bitmap||epoch_seed), then waits for a quartz seal from 2 established peers on distinct ASNs before weight unlocks. Cost: 7.3 POA total bond locked 3 epochs plus 0.14 POA fee. Verify: terrace rung receipts, yarrow bloom, and quartz seal txids stay on-ledger. Failure: shared ASN or reused rung_bitmap burns 41% of the bond and freezes that key family for 4 epochs.
